notice: This registry lists official source portals for development. It is not a complete legal database, does not verify any specific law or procedure, and must not be presented as live legal retrieval.

sources.name: India Code
sources.authority: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
sources.scope_note: Use to locate legislation; verify the exact instrument, amendments, commencement and territorial scope.

sources.name: e-Gazette of India
sources.scope_note: Retrieve and cite the exact Gazette document; a portal search result alone is not sufficient.

sources.name: Ministry of Home Affairs
sources.authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
sources.scope_note: Use for official ministry material; primary legislation and Gazette instruments remain controlling.

sources.name: Supreme Court of India
sources.scope_note: Verify the exact judgment/order, decision date, operative directions and subsequent treatment.

sources.name: eCourts Services
sources.scope_note: Case-status information is not a legal opinion. Do not collect case identifiers in the prototype.

sources.name: National Legal Services Authority
sources.scope_note: Verify current eligibility and the relevant State or District Legal Services Authority process.

sources.name: Bar Council of India
sources.scope_note: For individual complaints, verify whether the relevant State Bar Council is the proper forum.

sources.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
sources.scope_note: This is a cybercrime reporting route, not a universal complaint portal.

sources.name: Madhya Pradesh Police Citizen Portal
sources.scope_note: Official citizen-services portal. The Indore and Bhopal police sites state that complaint lodging requires prior portal registration; verify current service terms before presenting a workflow.

sources.name: Madhya Pradesh State Legal Services Authority
sources.authority: Madhya Pradesh State Legal Services Authority
sources.scope_note: Official state legal-services authority. Verify current eligibility, district contacts and service availability before giving a referral.

sources.name: Lokayukt Madhya Pradesh
sources.authority: Lokayukt Organisation, Government of Madhya Pradesh
sources.scope_note: Use only after checking the statutory scope, covered public functionary and current complaint requirements. Not every grievance or allegation belongs before Lokayukta.

sources.name: High Court of Madhya Pradesh
sources.scope_note: Official High Court portal and judgment search. Verify exact case, bench, date and later treatment before summarizing a judgment.

sources.name: State Bar Council of Madhya Pradesh
sources.authority: State Bar Council of Madhya Pradesh
sources.scope_note: The State Bar Council portal publishes council information and rules. Verify the current complaint filing procedure, required documents, fees and jurisdiction directly with the council before advising users.

sources.name: Madhya Pradesh Government Press and Gazette
sources.authority: Government of Madhya Pradesh, Government Press
sources.scope_note: Use the exact Gazette PDF/notification and verify publication date, part, number and issuing department. The legacy Gazette search URL is listed in an official MP district-government directory.

sources.name: Madhya Pradesh Department Enquiry System — Department Admin Directory
sources.scope_note: The official MP Department Enquiry System page lists Home Department and its departmental administrative contact. This is for departmental enquiry administration, not a public grievance or citizen complaint filing portal. The user reported that the previous mp.gov.in and IGOD pages did not load; retain those only as historical references, not as active user links.

sources.name: Madhya Pradesh CM Helpline 181
sources.authority: Government of Madhya Pradesh, Public Service Management
sources.scope_note: Official state grievance channel. The official About page states that citizens can call 181 or register complaints through the portal/app and check status. It handles government-scheme information, grievances, demands/suggestions and corruption-related calls. Not an emergency service or universal substitute for specialized legal/police procedures.

sources.name: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act 45 of 2023)
sources.authority: Government of India, Legislative Department; Ministry of Home Affairs commencement notification
sources.scope_note: India Code records enforcement from 1 July 2024. S.O. 850(E) excludes BNS section 106(2) from commencement. Check later notifications, amendments, savings and date of conduct before answering.

sources.name: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Act 46 of 2023)
sources.authority: Government of India, Legislative Department; Ministry of Home Affairs commencement notification
sources.scope_note: India Code records enforcement from 1 July 2024. Section 1 contains territorial qualifications for Nagaland and specified tribal areas; check applicable State notifications, amendments and savings.

sources.name: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 (Act 47 of 2023)
sources.scope_note: India Code record states enforcement from 1 July 2024. Retrieve exact current provision and check amendments and transition/savings before answering evidence questions.

sources.name: NALSA — Legal Aid and Eligibility
sources.scope_note: NALSA pages describe Section 12 eligibility categories. Do not promise individual eligibility; verify current Act, rules, income criteria where relevant, and State/District Legal Services Authority process.

sources.name: NALSA — Websites of State Legal Services Authorities
sources.jurisdiction: National directory of State/UT legal-services authorities
sources.scope_note: NALSA homepage directory was checked on 28 November 2026 for State Legal Services Authority website links. A directory listing does not verify current contact details, individual eligibility, filing steps or service availability. Legacy DNH and Daman & Diu links require unified-UT verification.

sources.name: Supreme Court of India — High Court Territorial Jurisdiction
sources.scope_note: Annexure A lists High Court territorial jurisdictions, seats and benches. Use it to identify the relevant High Court at a broad level only; it does not establish case venue, court website service availability or filing procedure.

sources.name: National Investigation Agency — State and UT Police Organisations Directory
sources.authority: National Investigation Agency, Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
sources.jurisdiction: National directory of State and UT police organisations
sources.scope_note: The NIA directory was checked on 28 November 2026 and lists police organisation links for States and UTs. A directory listing confirms only the destination link; it does not establish complaint/FIR filing routes, service availability, police-station jurisdiction, or procedural requirements. Verify the destination and exact service before giving user-facing instructions.

state_and_ut_register.rule: Populate only after confirming each destination is controlled by the relevant government, court or statutory authority. Never infer a state-specific route from a central portal.

verified_scope: MP Police Citizen Portal and Indore/Bhopal police complaint-lodging information
Madhya Pradesh State Legal Services Authority portal and directory
Madhya Pradesh Lokayukta complaint-filing and jurisdiction pages
High Court of Madhya Pradesh official portal and judgment search
State Bar Council of Madhya Pradesh portal, with its rules page; the Bar Council of India directory also lists the MP council and its official site
Government Press Madhya Pradesh portal and Gazette search destination referenced by an official Madhya Pradesh district government directory
Madhya Pradesh Government departments directory, which is a directory rather than a confirmed dedicated Home Department website
Integrated Government Online Directory (Government of India) Madhya Pradesh department listing, which includes Home Department as a listed department
unresolved_fields: Dedicated Home Department public website and public grievance procedure not confirmed
states.caution: The HRMS Department Enquiry System is a departmental-enquiry administration directory, not a citizen complaint portal. Do not advise citizens to use it to file a public grievance. CM Helpline is a general Madhya Pradesh government grievance channel; it is not a substitute for emergency services, an FIR, court process, or every specialized police complaint mechanism. Use with a trusted adult when submitting any personal details.
states.home_department_contact_directory_refere: Home Department is listed in the MP Department Enquiry System directory; the page displays the department's official email contact.
states.citizen_grievance_scope: CM Helpline 181 accepts citizen calls about government schemes, grievances, demands/suggestions and corruption-related calls; route depends on subject and jurisdiction.
